intent: Convert the CME orchestration prompt into a repository-bound, machine-checkable first iteration for GeoSync without promoting any research claim.
final_state: GeoSync has a validated CME iteration contract that an implementation agent can execute as the first step toward code, docs, tests, benchmarks, evidence, bibliography, and release verdicts.
first_missing_condition: A single machine-readable CME iteration contract must exist before recursive multi-agent improvement can be treated as operational engineering.

agent_plan.why: Bind the loop to existing canonical repository surfaces and prevent doctrine drift.
Translate SciML and physics-grade practices into software gates while blocking unsupported status language.
Derive one first missing condition and one next action from the desired final state.
Create only the minimal documentation, contract, validator, and test needed for this iteration.
Reject the iteration if the JSON contract, status tags, or claim guard fails.
Attack claim language, scope boundaries, replay paths, and false success reporting.
Define proxy comparisons for future runs without pretending real human evaluation occurred.
Preserve one-command validation and future onboarding path.
Keep the verdict honest and prevent release language before evidence exists.

implementation_tasks: Create the CME loop contract as repository documentation, not a claim promotion surface.
Create a machine-readable iteration JSON with the eleven required iteration fields.
Create a dependency-free validator that checks required fields, status tags, one first missing condition, validation commands, and claim-guard phrases.
Create a pytest wrapper that exercises the validator against the committed iteration contract.
Do not mark the iteration S1_TESTED until commands run and evidence is captured.

benchmark_ablation.future_measurement: Compare baseline agent output versus CME contract-bound output on claim safety, artifact completeness, validation command coverage, failure-mode detection, rollback clarity, and human-review load.
benchmark_ablation.forbidden: Do not report proxy scoring as real human evaluation.

failure_modes: The validator passes while the repository remains untested because local gates were not executed.
The loop becomes decorative documentation instead of changing validation behavior.
A future agent promotes hypothesis-tier work by language rather than evidence.
The benchmark reports proxy quality as real usefulness.
The release manager reports success without raw logs, exit codes, and manifest evidence.
verdict_criteria: PASS only if the JSON validator exits zero.
PASS only if pytest for the validator exits zero in a local or CI run.
PASS only if no blocked claim phrase appears in the iteration contract.
PASS only if the iteration remains S0_REPO_FACT plus S5_PROXY until commands are actually run.
FAIL if any validation command fails or cannot be reproduced.
next_cycle: Implement CME evidence-bundle generation for iteration outputs: raw logs, exit codes, checksums, validation report, failed gates, rollback plan, and VERDICT.md.

allowed_claims: CME uses physics-grade engineering principles as methodological imports.
CME implements proxy metrics for workflow quality.
CME can improve artifact stability only if validation gates pass.
GeoSync remains research software until evidence-bearing gates promote specific claims.
claim_governance.blocked_claim_phrase_policy: The validator rejects predeclared status-inflation phrases rather than storing the phrases here.
